title: Darth Maul will return again (again) for an animated series on Disney Plus
summary: Lucasfilm is producing Maul: Shadow Lord, a new solo animated series centered on Darth Maul, set roughly a year after the end of Star Wars: The Clone Wars. Sam Witwer returns to voice Maul and has been involved in script review. The series was revealed at Lucasfilm Animation’s 20th Anniversary panel and is expected to premiere on Disney Plus in 2026.
content:
The Star Wars villain will be back in Maul: Shadow Lord.

Lucasfilm is in production on a new solo animated series for the Star Wars villain you absolutely cannot keep down: Darth Maul. Despite having been killed on screen by Obi-Wan Kenobi twice over, Darth Maul will anchor the newly announced series Maul: Shadow Lord.

The news was revealed during Lucasfilm Animation's 20th Anniversary panel at Star Wars Celebration 2025, where director Dave Filoni and Lucasfilm vice president of animation Athena Portillo presented a trailer for Maul: Shadow Lord. According to reporting, the series takes place about a year after the events of the finale of Star Wars: The Clone Wars, when Maul failed to turn Ahsoka to the Dark Side.

Shadow Lord will center on Maul taking on an apprentice of his own, a storyline that leans into classic Sith themes of mentorship and power. The choice to continue Maul's arc explores how the character endures and evolves in the wake of previous defeats.

Sam Witwer, who voiced Maul in The Clone Wars and Star Wars Rebels, will return to the role and has been involved in reviewing scripts for the new series, according to Portillo. The involvement of original voice talent helps connect the new project to Maul's established animated history.

Maul: Shadow Lord is expected to premiere on Disney Plus in 2026. Fans at the panel reacted to the trailer reveal, and Lucasfilm framed the series as a continuation of Maul's complex trajectory within the wider Star Wars animated universe.

The announcement closes another chapter in Maul's recurring returns across Star Wars media and sets up a new era for the character on streaming television. Lucasfilm and Disney have not yet released a full episode schedule or additional casting details.
